# Complete Portfolio: Nurul Fajar

## Introduction
Nurul Fajar is a Mobile Software Engineer building Android and cross-platform apps with Java, Kotlin, Dart, Flutter, and Compose Multiplatform. He works at Duluin and has experience delivering HRIS, chat, and Android TV applications, from architectural design to production deployment.

## Detailed Project Catalog

3. **HRIS Mobile**
